notes: The retained0.43 authored map is immutable. Current content adds explicit royal/aristocratic route gates without changing its33jobs,16origin IDs or16encounter occupations. The reviewed estate-origin display-title override is recorded above.
Royal/aristocrat youth outfits cover the routes' ages16–17; adult/middle/elder outfits continue those roles.
World opt-in and the life's own world revision matter; do not assign a royal/aristocrat uniform from wealth, a name or an origin alone in older world revisions.
